main_idea: AQ-data warmup lifts Nemotron 3 Ultra's GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7, near teacher.
ideas: Warmup raises GDPval score by 11.4 points
Warmup nearly closes gap to teacher
Ultra has ~6x throughput of comparable open models
summary: A clear GDPval bar chart is cluttered by three stat cards that repeat the bars or add an unrelated throughput claim, plus a blog tag and a footer URL.
defects: Stat card text overflows the bottom of the middle and right cards
Teacher bar is dashed outline, with its value label overlapping the dashed top edge
